scenes.name: Speed/thrash metal
scenes.book: Heavy Metal: The Music and Its Culture
scenes.author: Deena Weinstein
scenes.desc: Si el lite metal es la corriente latitudinaria, el speed/thrash es la fundamentalista: un retorno a los principios de la subcultura heavy que, como todo fundamentalismo, es tanto un comienzo nuevo como una continuación. Nace en California en 1981-83 con Metallica en Los Ángeles y Exodus en San Francisco; hacia 1982 hay una escena de fans que intercambian maquetas y grabaciones piratas, y durante años solo graba en sellos independientes y suena en programas de radio universitaria: «underground» también en lo comercial. Bebe de la NWOBHM (Venom, Diamond Head, Iron Maiden) y del punk y el hardcore. Weinstein lo compara con la Reforma protestante: fuera la ropa de escena, el atrezo y la distancia; los músicos visten vaqueros y camiseta, se mezclan con el público y se tiran a él desde el escenario. Acelera el tempo, renuncia a lo dionisíaco (el alcohol y las drogas son malos, no hay sexo) y se especializa en un caos concreto: alienación, corrupción política, destrucción ambiental, una retórica de canción protesta.

podcast.title: Ace of Spades Bunk Selection (September 27, 1986)
podcast.body: The events leading to Cliff Burton's death began with the band drawing cards to decide bunk assignments on the tour bus. Cliff drew the Ace of Spades, giving him first choice, and he chose the bunk Kirk Hammett had been using, making the incident a tragic twist of fate. "Cliff drew the Ace of Spades which was the high card so he got to choose his bunk first."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Crushed by Bus in Sweden (September 27, 1986)
podcast.body: During the bus accident, Cliff Burton was thrown through a window and the bus rolled on top of him. While trapped, rescue crews attempted to use a winch and crane to lift the bus, but the cable slipped, crushing him a second time, which was definitively fatal. "As a winch and crane were used to raise the bus off Cliff, the cable slipped and he was crushed a second time and that most certainly killed him."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Fatal Tour Bus Accident (September 27, 1986)
podcast.body: Cliff Burton died on September 27, 1986, in Sweden during Metallica's tour for "Master of Puppets." After drawing the Ace of Spades to choose his bunk on the bus, he slept in Kirk Hammett's usual spot. The bus hit black ice around 7 a.m., causing the driver to lose control, resulting in the bus leaving the road and rolling onto its side. "He was the one who was killed and then awful tour bus accident in Sweden back on September 27, 1986."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Bunk Swap with Cliff Burton (September 27, 1986)
xref.body: On the night of the fatal bus crash that killed Cliff Burton, Kirk Hammett's usual bunk was chosen by Burton after a card game. Hammett, indifferent, opted for another bunk, inadvertently avoiding the fatal spot. "Cliff drew the Ace of Spades which was the high card so he got to choose his bunk first. And he chose the bunk that Kirk Hammett had been using."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Cliff Burton Death by Card Draw – September 27, 1986, Sweden, Winch Cable Slip
xref.body: During Metallica's European tour in support of *Master of Puppets*, the band drew cards to determine who got which bunks on the tour bus — Cliff Burton drew the Ace of Spades, a high card, and chose first, going to bed. Before dawn on September 27, 1986, between Stockholm and Copenhagen, the bus hit black ice, the driver lost control, and the vehicle left the road. Cliff was thrown from his bunk through a window and the bus rolled on top of him, badly injuring him. When rescue crews used a winch to lift the bus off Cliff, the cable slipped and he was crushed a second time — this almost certainly caused his death. He was 24. "And to think it all started with a cut of the cards."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Cliff Burton's Death (1986)
xref.body: Former Metallica bassist Cliff Burton died in a tour bus accident in 1986. His initials (CBL) and a transcription of his song "Orion" are tattooed on James Hetfield as a tribute. "That's a transcription of the song Orion, which is in tribute to former Metallica bass player Cliff Burton, who died in a tour bus accident in 1986."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Investigation for Black Ice (September 27, 1986)
xref.body: Following Cliff Burton's fatal bus accident, James Hetfield searched the highway extensively for the reported black ice but couldn't find any. This contributed to rumors surrounding the cause of the accident, though an investigation later ruled it a routine winter traffic accident. "James Headfield went up and down the highway looking for this black ice but he couldn't find any."

xref.title: CBL & Orion Tribute to Cliff Burton
xref.body: Above his right elbow, James has the letters "CBL," which are the initials of former Metallica bassist Cliff Burton. Under his inner left arm, there are musical notes that transcribe the song "Orion," a track written by Cliff Burton, serving as a tribute to him after his death in a 1986 tour bus accident. "Just above his right elbow are the letters CBL. Then there were some musical notes under his inner left arm. That's a transcription of the song Orion, which is in tribute to former Metallica bass player Cliff Burton, who died in a tour bus accident in 1986."

xref.title: Metallica Bassist Audition Anecdote
xref.body: There is a story that Les Claypool was offered the position of bassist in Metallica after Cliff Burton's death, but he did not get the job because, as quoted, "he was too good." "Now, there's a story that says he was offered the job of bassist in Metallica after the death of Cliff Burton, but he didn't get the job because, and this is a quote, he was too good."
